hypotheses.H1: quantity-only interaction measurements can remain buffered while reproductive function deteriorates because effective mating/post-pollination processes are downstream
hypotheses.H2: in fresh synchronized Q-E-F programmes, effective mating should localize the bottleneck; primary prediction Delta_QE=Q-E > 0 when mating quality is the missing stage, while Delta_EF distinguishes propagation, compensation, or later filtering
hypotheses.H3: F-dominant mismatch should be stronger or more frequent under source-supported outcrossing dependence and absent autonomous reproductive assurance

primary_estimand: Delta_QF=Q-F for quantity-function decoupling; H2-v2 primary Delta_QE=Q-E; secondary Delta_EF=E-F

regimes.B1: Delta_QF>0; Delta_QE>0; Delta_EF approximately zero: direct mating-quality propagation
regimes.B2: Delta_QF>0; Delta_QE>0; Delta_EF<0: mating bottleneck with downstream compensation
regimes.B3: Delta_QF>0; Delta_QE approximately zero; Delta_EF>0: post-mating/post-pollination bottleneck
regimes.B4: Q E F all deteriorate with unresolved/small contrasts: coupled chain deterioration
